scope: 696 canonical current published set rows; grouped by language and set.

definitions.directPublicVariantImage: An approved, public, active, non-deleted card-image asset linked to the exact variant in its current published catalogue version.
definitions.explicitSameVersionSharedArt: No direct image for the exact variant; its explicit same_artwork_as_variant_id points to a ready card image in the same current published catalogue version.
definitions.missingVariantImage: Neither of the two preceding conditions is present.
definitions.restoredSharedArtworkVariants: Variants included in the 10 September captured-artwork pointer restoration.

exclusions: Set logos, symbols, covers, pricing coverage and translations
